image.prompt: Midday on a sunny café terrace. Inês, sitting at a small round table with a galão, looks up with happy surprise as Tiago arrives with his earbuds around his neck; both raise a hand in a quick, casual 'hi'. Medium shot, eye-level, bright warm daylight, relaxed young-friends mood.

Early morning, 8:30, at the office coffee machine. Inês holds two paper cups and offers one to Yassin, who has just arrived with his backpack still on his shoulder, a bit sleepy but grateful. Soft low golden sunlight through the window, long shadows. Close two-shot, waist-up, faces large, warm start of the day.

About 3 pm, lift doors opening: Carlos, the manager, steps out holding a folder and a coffee; Yassin waits inside, holding the door with one hand and greeting him with a respectful nod and smile. Bright neutral afternoon light. Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Yassin toward Carlos, polite workplace mood.

image.prompt: Night, about 9 pm, at the entrance of Yassin's old apartment building and a warm lamp over the door. Yassin arrives home with a grocery bag; Dona Graça, his elderly neighbour, stands in the doorway in her cardigan and greets him with a gentle smile and a small wave. Medium shot, cool blue night with warm lamp light, cosy neighbourly mood. Nobody is sleeping.

At a desk on Yassin's first day: Yassin, slightly shy, places one hand on his chest as he introduces himself; Inês sits at the desk opposite, turned toward him, listening with a welcoming smile. A blank visitor badge clipped to his jacket. Close two-shot, waist-up, eye contact, warm morning office light.

In Carlos's small glass-walled office, Carlos leans back in his chair with an open-palm questioning gesture and a curious, kind expression, asking the new employee something; Yassin stands holding his laptop bag, about to answer. Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Yassin, Carlos's face clearly visible, morning light.

Yassin and Tiago shake hands firmly next to the office plants, both smiling broadly at their first introduction; Tiago's other hand pats Yassin's arm warmly. Close-up on the handshake in the foreground with both faces visible above it, warm light, happy first-meeting mood.

Right after a handshake, Inês laughs warmly and gives a small nod to Tiago, who grins back, both still turned toward each other by a window with soft city rooftops blurred behind them. Close two-shot, faces large, cheerful daytime light.

story_image.prompt: Wide but intimate scene inside the entrance hall of a modern office on Yassin's first day: Yassin, on the left, just arrived with his backpack and a visitor badge, offers his hand; Inês, on the right, steps toward him from the reception area with a big welcoming smile, mid-introduction. Morning sun through tall windows, a few colleagues of different ages blurred in the background, warm hopeful first-day mood.

image.prompt: Morning at the office kitchenette: Tiago, leaning on the counter with a banana in his hand, casually asks Yassin something with raised eyebrows and a friendly grin while Yassin pours water into a glass. Medium shot, relaxed colleague-to-colleague mood, soft daylight.
Yassin gives a thumbs-up with a relaxed smile in answer to Tiago, who nods back happily; both holding coffee cups by the office window. Close two-shot, waist-up, bright daylight, easy-going mood.

End of the workday, about 6 pm: Inês, putting on her jacket with her bag on her shoulder, points cheerfully forward with one finger raised as she says goodbye to Yassin, who is still at his desk closing his laptop. Medium shot, warm orange sunset light through the windows, cosy end-of-day mood.

Early evening at a small neighbourhood café: Manuel, in his apron, stands at the door flipping the sign to closed and waves goodbye with a big smile; Yassin walks away down the quiet street, turning back to wave. Wide street shot with plain shopfronts, golden hour light, friendly parting mood.

On the worn stone stairs of an old apartment building, Yassin meets Dona Graça coming down with her woven shopping basket; he stops, steps aside respectfully and greets her politely with a slight bow of the head. Medium shot on the stairs, soft morning light from a small window, respectful neighbourly mood.

Dona Graça answers Yassin with a warm, composed smile, one hand resting on her chest and the other holding the stair rail; Yassin listens attentively a step below her. Close shot on Dona Graça's face with Yassin in soft focus in the foreground, kind and polite mood.
